data.content: Keep your furniture beautiful for generations
While a vast majority of our pieces are delivered with in-home delivery and assembly included, it may become necessary for you to understand how to disassemble and reassemble your furniture.

data.title: Santa Monica Table & Extension Table
data.content: Tables ship with legs detached. Attach using provided hardware and Allen key. See assembly instructions included with your order for detailed steps.

data.title: Bosco, Wookie, Stowe, Warwick and Baxter Beds
data.content: Beds require two people for assembly. Headboard and side rails connect to footboard via provided bolts. See assembly instructions included with your order for detailed steps.

data.title: What finish is on my furniture?
data.content: Coffee and dining tables: hard-wearing, satin sheen conversion varnish. All other items: hand-applied oil and wax based finish. Both are very durable and highly resistant to water and wear, but not waterproof or scratch-proof.

data.title: How do I clean my furniture?
data.content: Use a plant-based wood cleaner or a microfiber cloth and water for daily cleaning and dusting. We recommend Vermont Naturals wood cleaner.

data.title: How do I use Lareaux's Furniture Paste Wax?
data.content: Apply paste liberally, allow to sit and soak for at least 15 minutes, then buff off excess with a soft clean cloth. Use quarterly to monthly. Each order ships with a small tin. Full 8oz tins available for purchase on the site.

data.title: What should I avoid?
data.content: Be careful setting hard, heavy items on table tops. Never drag items that may scratch. Don't allow liquids to pool on surfaces. Don't place hot items directly on surfaces — use a trivet or pad.

data.title: What about sunlight and humidity?
data.content: Sunlight will naturally lighten exposed areas over time. Relative humidity affects wood and may cause checking if humidity varies greatly. Maintain consistent indoor humidity when possible.
